title: Fourier tail bound for decision trees
statement: Let $T$ be a decision tree on $n$ binary coordinates whose outputs are always in $\\{-1,1\\}$, and let $k$ be a nonnegative integer. The sum of the squares of the Fourier coefficients of its output function over all subsets of coordinates of size greater than $k$ is at most the number of leaves of $T$ times $2^{-k}$.
hypotheses_covered: A decision tree on $n$ binary coordinates
Every output of the tree is $-1$ or $1$
